title: Portuguese Most Likely to Post Travel Selfies — Survey
paragraphs: Do you like to take photos of yourself on vacation and share them online? If you do, you are not alone. But according to a new study, people from Portugal like to do this more than other Europeans.

The study was done by Opodo, a travel company, and it was reported in October 2026. Opodo asked 9,000 travelers from the UK, the US, Portugal, Spain, Italy, Germany and France about how they use social media when they travel.

The study found that 50% of Portuguese travelers post selfies and personal photos from their trips. This was the highest number. Next were Spanish travelers, at 40%, and Italian travelers, at 35%. In Germany, the number was 30%, and in France, it was only 22%.
Portuguese travelers also shared other kinds of photos more than other people. For example, 88% of them shared photos of landscapes and famous places, and 66% shared photos of food.

The study also asked people about their trips that did not go well. More than half of Portuguese travelers, 54%, said they would still post nice things online about a trip that was disappointing. The number was 46% for Americans, but only 23% for Germans.

Social media also gives people ideas for new trips. In the US, 49% of travelers said social media made them want to visit a place they had not thought about before. For Gen Z, the youngest adults, the number was 59%. But for people aged 65 and older, it was only 5%.
Pablo Caspers, an executive at the company that owns Opodo, said that "Social media has become a powerful window to the world."
